tasks.title: Verify broken link checker and report results
tasks.prompt: Run 'npm run check:links', inspect the output in broken-links.log, and document any 404s found or confirm all links are healthy.

tasks.title: Run Astro and ESLint checks and document issues
tasks.prompt: Run 'npm run check:astro' and 'npm run check:eslint'. If any errors or warnings occur, record them in check_output.txt and summarize recommended fixes.
